entries.document: QSC WideLine-8 Series Loudspeaker System User Manual, TD-000237-00 rev D, copyright 2017, QSC LLC
entries.hostNote: QSC brand-owned domain. Host is not in source-host-allowlist.json; treat as a brand-domain source pending owner decision 8.
evidence: WL3082: 'The WL3082 loudspeaker is not equipped with a crossover network. All signal processing must be done before connecting audio power to the loudspeaker.'
WL3082: input is two Neutrik NL8 connectors wired in parallel; LF and HF transducers listed at 16 ohms.
WL212-sw: 'Input Connections' via NL8 and NL4 speakon, transducers listed at 4 ohms; 1100 W continuous; recommended crossover 30-85 Hz; input sensitivity 99 dB.
No passage uses the words 'passive' or 'active' for either model, and no amplifier is described as part of either enclosure.
entries.decision: active stays null for both records. The brief requires primary documentation that confirms passive/active. This manual supports passive operation but does not state it, so it does not meet that bar. Owner may decide whether passive-by-description is sufficient.

entries.document: Yamaha Malaysia NS-6490 product overview (manufacturer regional site; Malaysia variant)
entries.hostNote: my.yamaha.com not in source-host-allowlist.json; no promotion from it.
evidence: Driver: 20cm (8in) woofer, 10cm (4in) midrange, 2.2cm (7/8in) balanced-dome tweeter (three drivers).
Sensitivity 90 dB/2.83 V/m; frequency response 45-23,000 Hz; input power 140 W max / 70 W nominal; crossover 2.5 kHz and 8 kHz.
entries.decision: Malaysia publishes 6 ohms; US publishes 8 ohms (usa.yamaha.com). The two are separate regional variants and are not combined. Impedance stays UNAVAILABLE pending owner decision 7. driverCount 3 is independently supported by both regional pages.
